system.description:
Effect

If the artifice was used during combat, gain a +10 bonus to Gather Parts Encounter Conclusion action for that combat.

Effect

Reduces Vivisect AP cost by 1.

Effect

While active, you may expend the shell and 1 AP to make a Heavy attack with the weapon.

Effect

Instead of Arcane, the weapon may deal a different element of your choosing

Effect

When activated, the artifice instead changes to an element the wielder has mastered (their choosing). Still has the base element too as option.

Effect

You may alter the damage type from an attack made with this weapon for 0 AP. The damage type must be an element type you have mastered (usually unlocked through classes) or one that’s built into the weapon.

Effect

You may also fire this using 1 RP.

Effect

You do not roll damage on this weapon, but deal slightly higher than average damage. Instead it deals 6 damage on light attacks or 15 damage on heavy attacks. Critical strikes apply maximum damage as normal.

Effect

You do not roll damage on this weapon, but deal slightly higher than average damage. Instead it deals 6 damage on light attacks or 19 damage on heavy attacks. Critical strikes apply maximum damage as normal.

Effect

Heavy basic attacks strike an adjacent target in range with a light attack. Once per turn

Effect

You and allies affected by this device ignore 1 level of astra corruption increase caused by Exousiai type fiends.

Effect

When making the Overcharge attack, you may deal the extra light damage to all creatures within 5ft of the original target.

Effect

Your armor piercing effect range is increased to 60ft. If combined with a wrist mounted crossbow, increases the range but not the armor piercing range to 60ft.

Effect

Your armor piercing effect range is increased to 60ft.

Effect

Grants +1 to guard when out of RP.

Effect

The device now comes with 3 additional earplugs, letting more people listen in.

Effect

The range of the device increases from 1 mile to 3 miles.

name: Extra Range — Short Range Communications Device

system.description:
Effect

The range of the device increases from 1 mile to 2 miles.

Effect

Range is increased to 60ft, but the remain stealthed mechanic only applies when attacking within 30ft.

Effect

Dueling weapon passive changes to Aggressive Dueling: When attacking a single enemy 3 times with this weapon, your next basic attack has its cost reduced by 1 AP.

Effect

Removes the -10 penalty for finesse movements while wearing the gauntlets.

Effect

You may hold and use items or weapons like normal while wearing these gauntlets.

Effect

While it's active, you are immune to Burning.

Effect

When you crit with this weapon, the damage is still maximized even against blocking targets.

name: Flat Pommel — Hori (One-Handed) (Treated as a Small Weapon) / Small Weapons (One-Handed)

system.description:
Effect

When your other hand is free, you use your free hand to push the blade into targets increasing melee heavy attack damage to 5d6.

Effect

When your other hand is free, you use your free hand to push the target into targets increasing melee heavy attack damage to 5d6.

Effect

When you take the Dodge action, your next Block gains a +8 bonus. When you take the Block action, your next Dodge action gains a +4 bonus. Lasts until the start of your next turn. Can activate multiple times per turn, but does not stack.

Effect

When dealing damage to a target, the minimum damage you deal is always 2. (this does not trigger on damage effects if damage would be 0 otherwise).

Effect

At the start of your turn, you may change your threatened range to 5-10ft until the start of your next turn.

Effect

When you deal damage with a mystic eye ability, you make immediately make a Light attack against one of the targets you damaged with it. This counts as your dual wield attack.

Effect

Your Sweeping Arc now instead targets the same creature as the target of your Heavy attack.

Effect

Reduces the Initiative penalty by 1 and the Evasion/Dodge penalty by 2, but it also reduces the movement speed by 5ft.

Effect

When activated, it now lasts until the end of the encounter on a single shell use.

Effect

Your sweeping arc can now target all creatures within 5ft of you.

Effect

Gives Nimble II. After attacking an enemy with a light attack on your turn, you may move 10ft. This movement only provokes attacks of opportunity if that movement would put you out of melee range of the target.

Effect

Polearm weapon passive changes to +10ft and your threatened range becomes 5-15 ft. Having this item in your burden reduces your max RP by 1.

Effect

When you are struck by a critical hit and you do not defend against it, you can make a 0 RP opportunity attack before the triggering attack. You can spend 1 RP to instead make it a heavy attack.

Effect

Allows the user to install a grappling hook artifice in the arm, functioning just like the grappling hook would. (Grappling hook must be supplied separately and takes an errand action from an artificer to install). A grappling hook installed in the arm takes burden like usual and still takes an AP to activate, but requires no AP to pull out.

Effect

You may wield a Two-Handed weapon with the hand this gauntlet is on. Any other actions that require a free hand normally such as grabbing a potion not doable.

Effect

When used, up to 3 other allies within 10ft of you may choose to escape with you. Increases the AP cost by 2, potentially giving it the setup keyword.

Effect

While stationary, you may extend the effect of this device to all medium or smaller creatures within 5ft of you.

Effect

The crit threshold of this weapon is lowered by 5, but you no longer maximize damage dice or gain full pierce on a crit.

Effect

Attacks with this weapon have -1 Power, but you can make 2 offhand attacks per turn instead of one.

Effect

This weapon also gains the axe passive (Wild Swing).

Effect

Grants Keen II lowers the crit threshold by 2 (replaces Keen).

Effect

This weapon is now considered a two-handed weapon.

Effect

Increases thrown power by 2 but boomerang/returning effects no longer work.

Effect

You retain the guard bonus even while using the weapon with two hands, the block value increases by +4 when wielding with one hand and no other weapon or shield in your other hand.

Effect

Unarmed attacks made with this weapon deal 5d6 damage instead of 4d6.

Effect

The grappling hook can support 1 additional ally to move with you.

Effect

Grants a +1 power or +1 focus bonus, but cannot gain the benefits from base material bonuses. This bonus is actually 100% from hype.

Effect

The device is disguises as a regular object, making it not appear as a private communications device. (Closer inspection or perception checks may still reveal it as such).

Effect

You gain a +1 bonus to your accuracy when making a basic Heavy or precise attack.
system.source: Flo's Madness · Weapons + Artifices item mods

system.description:
Effect

When dealing damage with an attack of opportunity against an enemy leaving your range, you may pull them back 5ft. Only triggers once per turn.
